goal: Allow wallet users to manually rebroadcast unconfirmed transactions directly from the RPC and GUI
Avoids the tedious workaround of extracting raw transaction hex to resend dropped transactions
reviewability: Nothing known that would invalidate a review
agreement: Broad concept support for giving users manual rebroadcast capability
Unaddressed objection: fails with an empty error message when feerate exceeds -maxfeerate (fametrano)
Open suggestions to drop a redundant lock and cache transaction depth (pseudoramdom)
Open request to add a release note for the new RPC and GUI action (polespinasa)

categories.name: wallet
why: P3 because it adds a direct manual rebroadcast feature to RPC and GUI for dropped transactions
Solves a clear usability pain point over extracting raw hex but is reasonably deferrable
